scope: Complete current implementation and tests, not every historical frozen version or experiment artifact.

files.derivative_reason: Local absolute project root replaced by the archive-relative root.
Explicit origin argument replaces the pinned deployment address; no credentials in source.
Use a configured compiler and Python launcher rather than scanning a host-specific drive.
Legacy notebook check is explicitly skipped when excluded; a new test checks its absence and driver syntax.
Mock origin supplied explicitly; rejects credentials/path/token before network requests.

manifest_self_hash: Intentionally excluded to avoid circular hashing; the RAR is hashed externally.

excluded.reason: Obsolete first-firmware notebook; current driver sources and tests are included.
Chronological workstation instructions replaced by an anonymous, portable source README.
Submission-specific ignore rules exclude generated data, binaries and secrets.
Historical snapshots, generated candidates/RTL and experimental data are not current implementation source; originals are retained separately.
Administrative, connection and chronological records are not code; selected contracts and scope docs are included.
Third-party runtime/downloads, prior documents and generated caches are excluded.

excluded.path: Credentials, registration screenshots, model weights, tool installers, bitstreams and HWH
excluded.reason: Not source-code deliverables; no secret or personal identity materials are included.

license: No new license for project-original code. AMD board XML MIT license retained verbatim.

privacy_scan.scope: Every text file in this source tree; loopback endpoints and synthetic path fixtures remain.
